Reason: The provided images are fetal ultrasounds (not chest X-rays) showing a cystic lung lesion with systemic arterial supply (color Doppler), characteristic of a bronchopulmonary sequestration; such lesions typically arise in the lower/middle lobe region and can cause mass effect displacing the heart and elevating the hemidiaphragm, making option B the most clinically consistent description among the choices despite the modality mismatch.
